newsitem.title: FRANCE: DOUBT HANGS OVER MULTIANNUAL RAFALE ORDER.
newsitem.headline: DOUBT HANGS OVER MULTIANNUAL RAFALE ORDER.

text.p: Sources close to the French defence ministry said on Monday that the Rafale fighter plane did not currently figure among the defence programmes which would involve multiannual orders.

Under the former centre-right government, there has been an agreement in principle under which the government could issue an order for 48 Rafale craft between 1998 and 2002 in return for a 10 percent price reduction.

A first tranche of the order, to the tune of 13 Rafales, had been expected to be made by the previous government between the first and second round of the parliamentary election -- on May 25 and June 1 -- which swept the current Socialist-led coalition to power.
The sources said on Monday said that the plan had not been called into question but that it would now be considered in the context of the draft 1998 budget bill preparations.
